_doc: Per-car visual audit of the Toyota clean set against the owner's rubric (CLAUDE.md 'Per-car audit rubric'). PASS = ships. Written incrementally: the container is ephemeral and an audit is expensive to redo.

1.name: 2026 Toyota Prius
1.note: wheels absent in 3 of 4 views -- empty arches front and rear; body panels ripple along the flank

4.name: Toyota RAV4 Adventure
4.note: wheel style changes between views: black off-road alloys front34/side, silver alloys rear34; crease artefacts on rear quarter

5.name: Toyota Avensis MK1 T22 1997-2003
5.note: severe -- tyres missing, bare brake discs, one wheel detached and floating under the car, body panels exploded and misaligned

6.name: 2023 Toyota GR Corolla
6.note: proportions read as GR Corolla instantly; strong front 3/4; wheels consistent across all four views; grille has real depth; shut lines defined; reflections clean

7.name: 2023 Toyota GR86
7.note: reads as GR86 instantly; strong front 3/4; identical black multi-spoke wheels in all four views; headlights have internal LED elements; shut lines crisp; clean reflections

9.name: Toyota Auris 2019
9.note: proportions right; grey multi-spoke wheels consistent across views; grille honeycomb has real depth; pillars and wheelbase consistent; premium finish

10.name: Toyota bZ4X
10.note: reads as bZ4X instantly; black cladding correct; wheels identical in all four views; shut lines defined; clean reflections

3.name: Toyota_Supra_GT500_2005
3.note: out of scope, not a quality fault -- Super GT / JGTC race car: full aero wing, slicks, roll cage, no road lighting. No UK reg decodes to this. Geometry itself is sound

13.name: 1998 Toyota Land Cruiser
13.note: reads as J80 Land Cruiser instantly; 6-spoke alloys consistent in all four views; grille lettering crisp; shut lines defined; premium finish. Nit: number plate carries custom text, wants blanking before it ships

8.name: Toyota_gt86
8.note: proportions right but below the premium bar: wheel spokes are soft low-poly blobs with no alloy definition, headlights are dark voids with no internal LED elements, grille shallow. Note this is the first-gen ZN6 GT86, a generation #7 does not cover
